chunks: And by this chain, from Abaan, from Yaqoub ibn Shuayb, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
about the Statement of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Mankind were one community'
so he said: 'The people before Noah were a misguided nation'
So Allah initiated by sending the Messengers
And it is not as they are saying that it never ceased
Allah differentiates in the Night of Power what was of hardship or ease or rain
in accordance with what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, desires to decree, until the similar like it comes (Next Night of Power)
ai.seo_question: What does the Imam say about the meaning of 'Mankind were one community' and the Night of Power?
ai.summary: Abu Abdillah (as) clarifies that pre-Noahic humanity constituted a single misguided nation, prompting Allah to send Messengers to guide them, thereby refuting the notion of an immutable divine decree. He further illustrates Allah's active will by citing the Night of Power, where He distinguishes between hardship and ease, or rain and drought, according to His specific measure for each coming year.

en.sarwar: 40. and by this chain, from Abaan, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb, who has said: I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s.)
about the Statement of Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic: “[2:213] Mankind were one community”
, so he (a.s.) said: ‘Before the era of Noah (as) the people were a misguided nation.
So Allah (azwj) Initiated by sending the Messengers (as)
and it is not as they are saying it to be that it never ceased
for Allah (azwj) Differentiated in the Night of Power (Laylat Al-Qadr) what was from the hardships, or ease, or rain
in accordance with what Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic so Desired until the similar like it to come (Next Laylat Al-Qadr)’.
